name: agent-harness
description: A coordinator plus three roles (researcher, implementer, evaluator) with a session budget, an accident catcher and an audit trace. Model-agnostic instructions; enforcement wired for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinator + three roles, with enforcement that holds when instructions don't.
interface.longDescription: Turns Codex into a coordinator that plans, delegates to a researcher, an implementer and an evaluator, and refuses work the evaluator hasn't passed. Ships four on-demand skills (OpenAPI client generation, Liquibase changesets, DDD/ArchUnit layering, Quarkus testing) and a hook layer: a session tool-call budget, an accident catcher and an audit trace under .agent/. The sandbox and approval policy are project settings and do not travel with the plugin — copy .codex/config.toml into your project.
defaultPrompt: Add pagination to the /users endpoint, with tests.
Research how the OpenAPI contract is wired before changing it.
